jobs.title: Director/Senior Director - Acquisitions, San Francisco
jobs.description:
Director/ Senior Director – Acquisitions

Tishman Speyer creates vibrant destinations and dynamic environments that inspire innovation and connected communities. As a diversified developer, operator, and investment manager of top-tier real estate in 33 markets across the globe, our business choices are driven by the belief that real estate should unlock human potential. Tishman Speyer’s diversified portfolio spans market rate and affordable residential communities, premier office properties and retail spaces, industrial facilities, and mixed-use campuses. We create state-of-the-art life science centers through our Breakthrough Properties joint venture, and foster innovation through our strategic proptech investments. By combining global perspective with local expertise, and a personalized approach, we are able to anticipate our customers’ evolving needs. We were the first real estate company to introduce asset-wide amenity services through our ZO platform, and the first traditional real estate company to create its own flexible space and coworking brand, Studio.

Since our founding in 1978, Tishman Speyer has acquired, developed, and operated 522 properties, totaling 218 million square feet, with a combined value of over $129 billion (U.S.). Tishman Speyer currently has approximately $68 billion in assets under management, including iconic properties such as Rockefeller Center in New York City, The Springs in Shanghai, TaunusTurm in Frankfurt, and Mission Rock in San Francisco.

Summary of the Position:
The Director/Senior Director of Acquisitions will join as a member of the San Francisco Acquisitions team, primarily responsible for sourcing and executing acquisitions opportunities in the San Francisco Bay Area and the Seattle metropolitan area. This person will also serve as a thought leader in the office helping to think through the strategic direction of the existing office and multifamily portfolio. This individual will be involved in all aspects of investment activity, including: underwriting and financial modeling; deal structuring; coordinating due diligence; supporting financings; negotiating terms’ and shepherding deals through internal review and Investment Committee approval processes.

Key Responsibilities:
· Generate, screen and assess investment ideas and themes
· Lead or support all aspects of investment activity, from deal origination to transaction execution: source, underwrite, and structure investment opportunities in the Bay Area and Seattle MSA.
· Conduct commercial, legal and financial due diligence; perform valuation, market and risk analyses of office, multifamily, industrial and life sciences assets
· Work closely with team members to optimize deal structure by negotiating term sheets and agreements with partners
· Develop business plans and exit strategy with asset management teams
· Foster relationships with management teams and internal and external stakeholders
· Develop and maintain contact with lenders, brokers, developers, consultants, and investors
· Assist with other strategic special projects including investor presentations and capital markets strategy for the existing portfolio
· Train and mentor junior team members

Skills & Qualifications:
· 8+ years of experience in an analytically rigorous Real Estate role, with preference for relevant market knowledge
· Exceptional analytical skills and financial acumen
· Collaborative nature willingness to build and sustain productive working relationships with colleagues across various teams
· Strong verbal and written presentation skills
· Conscientious attention to detail
· Ability to travel up to 20% of the time

The base compensation range for this role is $160,000 to $230,000. This role is also eligible for a discretionary annual bonus, as well as access to our comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, life and disability insurance, 401(k) plan (with matching contributions), wellness benefits and all other benefits afforded to full-time Tishman Speyer employees.
This base range reflects a number of factors including, but not limited to, relevant experience, skill sets, and/or licensure required of an individual in this particular role. The base range is also specific to members of Tishman Speyer’s San Francisco team, as we’ve considered factors specific to this geography.

- Analyze and manage tracking of various ongoing capital projects in coordination with design & construction teams and property management.

- 3-5 years of experience in an analytically rigorous Real Estate or Finance environment

- Evident passion for real estate and desire to build a career on the principal side

- Effective written and oral communication skills

Summary of the Position:
Tishman Speyer is seeking an experienced hospitality leader to serve as General Manager of a class A commercial property in New York City. Reporting to the Deputy Regional Director, this position offers a unique opportunity to oversee the day-to-day operations of one of the world’s most iconic and recognized commercial properties while delivering a best-in-class guest experience to customers, visitors and stakeholders.  You will lead a high-performing, service-oriented team, elevating the standard of operational excellence and hospitality with the goal of providing the highest quality experience to establish and foster long-term customer relationships. You will work with key Senior Management stakeholders to develop and execute asset plans aligned with the overall investment strategy.   In addition, this role will play a critical leadership role in the planning, coordination, and execution of the building’s redevelopment, partnering closely with Asset Management, Design & Construction, Leasing, and ownership stakeholders to reposition the asset as a best-in-class property and deliver the long-term vision for this iconic asset.

The successful candidate will bring a hospitality mindset, a wealth of operational and financial expertise and the ability to successfully lead a matrixed team.

Key Responsibilities:
Hospitality / Leadership:
- Lead the Property Management and Maintenance teams with a hospitality-first philosophy, delivering seamless and elevated experiences throughout the property.
- Champion and curate customer touchpoints- from lobby experience to amenity activation-with a focus on personalization, white-glove service, and community engagement in addition to traditional operations management.
- Understand business needs and leverage our platform to solve real estate challenges.
- Coordinate unique ZO. event programming with a focus on creating and maintaining a community atmosphere.
- Partner with Asset Management on various projects as determined by regional leaders and/or Managing Director.
- Responsible for the relationship between Owner and Property Management Agreement(s).
- Collaborate with the Leasing Team on all aspects, inclusive of marketing, relationship management and advertising campaigns.
- Responsible for City agency registrations and maintaining DOB, HPD, DOL, and 3rd party relations.
- Lead a cross-functional team to ensure all corporate objectives, policies and standards are met.
- Develop direct reports through mentoring. Identify growth potential and set objectives to achieve career advancement.

Operations:
- Lead property operations in support of a multi-million-dollar redevelopment, coordinating with internal and external stakeholders to ensure successful execution of redevelopment initiatives while maintaining operational excellence and an exceptional customer experience throughout the project lifecycle
- Own the annual operating budget and capital plan, including forecasting, variance analysis, reporting and presentation to internal stakeholders and partners.
- Budget management and financial reporting for profit and loss variances, quarterly reforecasting, and investor reports.
- Work with the accounting team to ensure the accuracy of financial reporting.
- Oversee the management of third-party maintenance contractors to ensure compliance with contractual obligations.
- Facilitate pre-built, landlord-built, customer-built projects, and drawing reviews.
- Direct all base building capital and major repair and maintenance projects; track and manage finances for projects.
- Collaborate with the Design & Construction team with building projects and customer communications.

About You:
- 7+ years of experience in luxury hospitality operations or facilities management, including oversight of large teams and high-profiles properties.
- Deep understanding of guest experience best practices, luxury service standards and experiential operations.
- Prior experience project managing capital projects
- Bachelor’s degree required.
- Financial management and business operations experience required
- Proficient in Microsoft Office or equivalent
- Ability to travel between floors and buildings in order to effectively communicate with the team and customers

Critical Competencies for Success:
- Experience managing a multi-layered team
- Takes initiative and is proactive leader always focused on continuous improvement
- Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills
- Strong organizational and project management skills
- Passion for working with people, creating amazing experiences, and leading with a hospitality mindset
- Eager to be a part of a fast-paced and dynamic work environment

Additional Requirements:
- Prolonged periods of standing
- Frequent walking
- Occasionally lift and/or move 10-20 lbs

This role is also eligible for a discretionary annual bonus, as well as access to our comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, life and disability insurance, 401(k) plan (with matching contributions), wellness benefits and all other benefits afforded to full-time Tishman Speyer employees. Summary of the Position:
The Director, Operational Excellence, Client Experience, & Strategy is a senior leader responsible for operational performance, service quality, client satisfaction, accountability, continuous improvement, and strategic growth across the commercial cleaning portfolio. Reporting to the Senior Director, CSTS, this role partners with the Managing Director, Operations, Account Management, Human Resources, and senior leadership to resolve significant concerns, strengthen account performance, protect client relationships, and translate field intelligence into scalable business improvements. The role leads the Manager, Quality Assurance & Client Experience and provides an objective, field-based view of performance across the portfolio.

Key Responsibilities:
Quality Assurance & Operational Excellence
• Lead the portfolio quality-assurance framework, including inspection standards, scoring, reporting, escalation protocols, and performance expectations.
• Review inspection results, complaints, corrective actions, and performance trends to identify systemic issues, operational risk, and opportunities for improvement.
• Provide leadership with independent visibility into service quality, management responsiveness, recurring deficiencies, and account health.
• Set clear ownership for corrective actions, evaluate effectiveness, and partner with operational leaders on account-stabilization strategies.
• Develop scalable operating practices, metrics, training priorities, and improvement initiatives that enhance productivity and service quality.

Client Experience & Relationship Leadership
• Serve as the senior escalation point for significant, recurring, or relationship-threatening client concerns.
• Engage directly with clients, participate in business reviews and strategic discussions, and align corrective-action plans with client expectations.
• Use client feedback and service trends to anticipate renewal risk, support retention, and strengthen confidence in the organization.
• Provide strategic oversight for new-account transitions and startups so quality standards, accountability, inspection routines, and expectations are established from inception.

Leadership, Training & Accountability
• Lead and develop the Manager, Quality Assurance & Client Experience, including priorities, standards, field coverage, reporting, and follow-through.
• Partner with Operations and Human Resources on documented performance trends, coaching, retraining, supervision, and other appropriate corrective measures.
• Identify portfolio-wide training needs and coordinate programs covering cleaning standards, quality expectations, client service, documentation, safety, and accountability.
• Influence results across organizational boundaries through facts, analysis, practical recommendations, and consistent executive communication.

Strategic Growth & Business Development
• Leverage experience, industry relationships, and market knowledge to identify and pursue growth opportunities within and beyond Tishman Speyer properties.
• Identify opportunities to expand existing relationships through additional services, scope enhancements, operational solutions, and other value-added offerings.
• Partner with the Managing Director, Senior Director, and Account Managers on growth strategy, client presentations, renewals, business reviews, proposals, and account plans.
• Provide operational and client intelligence that informs pricing, positioning, competitive differentiation, and new-business development.
• Promote measurable quality assurance, responsiveness, operational discipline, and continuous improvement as differentiators in the marketplace.

Skills & Qualifications:
A field-oriented, commercially minded leader who combines cleaning-operations expertise, client advocacy, business-development judgment, and the ability to turn service intelligence into stronger performance, lasting relationships, and profitable growth.

• 15+ years of experience in commercial cleaning or janitorial operations, preferably with one or more well-regarded cleaning providers serving New York City.
• Demonstrated experience leading cleaning operations and managing quality across multiple commercial properties or accounts.
• Client-facing sales or business-development experience working with property owners, asset managers, property managers, or other real-estate decision-makers.
• Strong understanding of commercial cleaning operations, labor-intensive service delivery, client retention, complaint resolution, and account growth.
• Experience working in a unionized workforce and collective-bargaining environment, preferably 32BJ.
• Strong analytical, root-cause, presentation, negotiation, organizational, and executive-communication skills.
• Ability to move comfortably among client meetings, property walks, operational reviews, employee and supervisor discussions, and executive presentations.
• Ability and willingness to conduct field visits during cleaning-service hours, including evenings and other off-hours as required.
• Proficiency with reporting and productivity software, including Microsoft Office Suite, inspection and performance-tracking systems.
• Demonstrated ability to leverage emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence, automation, and data-driven tools, to improve efficiency, enhance decision-making, and drive innovation.

*Onsite presence is required for this position

The base compensation range for this role is $175,000 to $190,000. This role is also eligible for a discretionary annual bonus, as well as access to our comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, life and disability insurance, 401(k) plan (with matching contributions), wellness benefits and all other benefits afforded to full-time Tishman Speyer employees.
